articles.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
articles.snippet: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

articles.title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
articles.snippet: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.
